parallels.note: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor…

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem

translations.web: Now when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.
translations.bsb: When all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the army with him, they rejoiced,
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
translations.asv: Now it came to pass that, when all the people that were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
